_doc: Registry by source type. daily_scan defines daily coverage and core_pool lists regular starting points. Confirm the identities of accounts marked verify and periodically check accounts marked watch.

layers.official: Official listings, product releases, derivatives markets and governance announcements
layers.founder: Public disclosures from founders and core contributors
layers.kol: Independent analysis, market commentary and discussion leads
layers.data: Large transactions, exchange volumes and capital flows for cross-checking

api_pending_key.note: Retired. CryptoPanic ended its free Developer API on April 1, 2026. All endpoints tested on June 23 returned 404. Access requires a paid plan. CryptoCompare/CCData now requires a key and returned 401. Use RSS and web search for live coverage.

sourcing_rule: Start with project research, attributed discussion and ecosystem discovery. Check RSS for omissions. Verify rules against official sources. Record speakers, affiliations, dates and primary links. Distinguish independent evidence from promotion. Where X API access is unavailable, use public pages and named interviews and document gaps. Use same-day, comparable market figures. Distinguish perpetuals protocols, frontends, spot infrastructure and prediction markets. Small funding rounds or low volume alone do not disqualify useful early projects. Preserve publication dates and record checked_at separately.
